test_initializers_zeros_ones: test the initializers Zeros and Ones to verify they produce constant tensors with correct mean and max values
test_initializers_constant: test the initializers Constant to verify it fills tensors with a scalar value and rejects invalid types
test_initializers_random_normal: test the initializers RandomNormal to verify it generates tensors with correct mean and standard deviation
test_initializers_variance_scaling: test the initializers VarianceScaling to verify Glorot, Lecun, and He initialization modes with different distributions
test_initializers_orthogonal: test the initializers Orthogonal to verify generated matrices satisfy orthogonality constraints
